```powershell
Write-Output '=== JOB 527 - CONTROLS APPLIED IN ONE MOTION (Ground: his order - apply what you have learned, go go go. This job applies the whole seat in one motion: a gated patcher strips every trigger axis out of the input ini movement mappings, seats Fire on the right trigger and aim on the left trigger through the direct key road inside her input setup, prints its readback, and the build runs in the same job with its verdict read from the build log result line. $p527b64 = ''
$p527py = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\Saved\patch527.py'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p527py, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p527b64))
$p527wait = 0
while ((Get-Process -Name ('UnrealEdito' + [char]114) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $p527wait -lt 6) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $p527wait = $p527wait + 1 }

& 'C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\python.exe' $p527py

$p527uproj = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\VEIL.uproject'
```
